name: commitguard
description: CommitGuard - Embedded Pre-Commitment Interceptor for Payments & Embedded Finance

scripts.build:extension: esbuild src/extension/content.tsx --bundle --outfile=src/extension/build/content.js --loader:.tsx=tsx --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\" && esbuild src/extension/background.ts --bundle --outfile=src/extension/build/background.js --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\" && tailwindcss -i src/extension/styles.css -o src/extension/build/styles.css --minify && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('src/extension/manifest.json','utf8'));m.background.service_worker='background.js';m.content_scripts[0].js=['content.js'];m.web_accessible_resources[0].resources=['styles.css'];fs.writeFileSync('src/extension/build/manifest.json',JSON.stringify(m,null,2));fs.mkdirSync('src/extension/build/icons',{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync('src/extension/icons')){fs.copyFileSync('src/extension/icons/'+f,'src/extension/build/icons/'+f);}"
